description: Use when you must check infrastructure in one call: any combination (at least one) of ip (ASN, Tor exit, cloud range), domain (status, TLS, robots), cve (CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV). Returns the paid x402 request for your input (GET /check/infra, $0.015 per call; schema linked). Call that URL with an x402 or MPP client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge. For one input use ip_passport, vuln_cve, package_risk or software_eol; for DNS, SPF, DMARC and registration use domain_report; for sitemap or WordPress use site_snapshot. With an access key (Authorization: Bearer p0k_..., buy at https://x402-bazaar-rank.x402-bazaar-rank-worker.workers.dev/keys/buy?usd=5) the tool pays the call itself, returns the data and deducts the price. First call each day returns the data itself, free; later calls return the paid request.

domain.description: Host name of your site, e.g. example.com

ip.description: Public IPv4 or IPv6 address. At least one of ip, domain, cve, package, software is required

package.description: ecosystem:name@version, e.g. npm:lodash@4.17.15 (npm, PyPI, Go, crates.io, RubyGems, Maven, NuGet)

name: check_infra
title: Check infra
